verdict.rationale: Wave's first-party docs say the Pro Plan will 'automatically import, merge, and categorize your bank transactions', which covers automatic categorization of imported transactions, but only on the paid tier. Nothing in the evidence shows categorization presented as reviewable suggestions, or a model that learns from the user's corrections or applies user-defined rules. Missing for 10: evidence of suggestion review/acceptance, learning from corrections or rule creation, availability beyond the paid Pro tier, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
